paper_record.title: Exchange splitting as a descriptor for giant anomalous Hall and Nernst effects in ferromagnets
paper_record.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE), which describe transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses in magnetic materials, respectively, are promising for spintronic and energy-harvesting applications. Here, we employ high-throughput first-principles calculations to investigate 2251 chemically substituted tetragonal $L1_0$ alloys. Among ferromagnets, enhanced responses emerge preferentially in alloys derived from parent compounds with small exchange splitting: no alloy derived from FePt, the archetypal $L1_0$ ferromagnet, reaches the high-response regime, whereas NiPt- and CoIr-derived alloys occupy it in large numbers. Small exchange splitting keeps majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, giving chemical substitution more opportunity to modify near-Fermi-level band crossings and amplify the Berry curvature. We predict a giant anomalous Hall conductivity of $2809\,\mathrm{S\,cm^{-1}}$ in (Co$_{0.8}$Fe$_{0.2}$)(Ir$_{0.7}$Pt$_{0.3}$) and a giant anomalous Nernst conductivity of $7.72\,\mathrm{A\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ in (Ni$_{0.8}$Co$_{0.2}$)(Pt$_{0.7}$Ir$_{0.3}$). Our results identify the exchange splitting of the parent compound as a descriptor for chemical tunability toward giant Berry-curvature-driven transport responses.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文通过高通量计算表明，较小的交换分裂可作为预测铁磁母体化合物化学调控以获得巨反常霍尔和能斯特效应的有效描述符。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work demonstrates through high-throughput calculations that small exchange splitting serves as a descriptor for identifying ferromagnetic parent compounds with high chemical tunability for giant anomalous Hall and Nernst effects.

problem.zh: 如何在庞大的化学替代空间中，高效筛选和设计具有巨反常霍尔与反常能斯特效应的磁性材料，避免盲目的高通量计算。
problem.en: How to efficiently screen and design magnetic materials with giant anomalous Hall and anomalous Nernst effects within a vast chemical substitution space, avoiding brute-force screening.

approach.zh: 使用第一性原理计算和虚拟晶体近似，对2251种四方L10合金的电子结构和拓扑输运性质进行高通量模拟。
approach.en: Employing high-throughput first-principles calculations and the virtual crystal approximation to simulate the electronic structures and topological transport properties of 2251 tetragonal L10 alloys.

main_takeaway.zh: 较小的交换分裂使多数和少数自旋能带同时保留在费米能级附近，为化学替代调控能带交叉和放大贝里曲率提供了更多空间。
main_takeaway.en: Small exchange splitting keeps both majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, providing more opportunities for chemical substitution to modify band crossings and amplify Berry curvature.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究提出了基于交换分裂的材料设计原则，能有效缩小候选材料的搜索范围，指导自旋电子学和热电能量收集材料的研发。
why_it_matters.en: This study proposes a materials-design principle based on exchange splitting, which effectively narrows the search space and guides the development of materials for spintronics and thermoelectric energy harvesting.

reason.zh: 明确了母体化合物交换分裂大小与化学调控敏感性之间的物理关联，并预测了数个具有巨响应的新型合金。
reason.en: Clarified the physical link between the exchange splitting of parent compounds and their chemical tunability, and predicted several new alloys with giant responses.

reason.zh: 该工作结合了高通量计算、材料设计描述符的提出以及拓扑物性预测，非常符合该期刊的定位。
reason.en: This work combines high-throughput calculations, the proposal of a materials design descriptor, and topological property predictions, which fits the journal's scope well.
